title: Icy Cold Frog
description: Turns the Cold Frog texture from a lush tropical green (which doesn't fit in the cold biomes) into a more fitting Icy Skin for the Cold Frog.
body:
A simple resourse pack that improves the Cold Frog's Texture to be more, well, uh, cold.
# Issues
None except for the games panarama being non-existent.
